title: Phase 3 execution, Layer 3: round 5 — verify the round-4 fixes, re-decide the stop

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST (declared before the spend). invoked_by: the standing continuation conduct. vehicle: the Workflow surface (background; the resume net caches completed lenses). round shape: STOP-DECIDING VERIFY, scope NARROWED to the round-4 change set (800878a5): the category-based cleaner + the new dependency, the PostLoad registry-string cleaning at load, the three real falsifiers, the declared Layer 4 scope. THREE lenses: security (does the category approach actually close the class — is there any terminal-unsafe code point NOT in Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp that the threat model wants stripped, and conversely does the category set over-strip any legitimate text; is the dependency's category data trustworthy for a security control; any surface still bypassing the shared helper or the load-time clean), software-engineer (the PostLoad hook's correctness — is it called on every load path, do all set types have their impl, is the no-op default right; the dependency integration; the falsifiers' soundness; regressions), quality-engineer (do the round-4 falsifiers falsify — the category unit tests, the post_load unit test, the escaped-key command test, the hostile-path pin, the registered_absence pin; is the command test now genuinely non-vacuous; any overfit from the category tests). CONVERGENCE NOTE for the operator: rounds 1-3 fixed members, round 4 fixed the classes — if round 5 holds, the loop has converged and Layer 3 reaches its boundary; if it finds another real defect, that is signal the surface is deeper than estimated and worth the operator's attention on scope. MODEL/EFFORT chosen: fable all three; security/SE high, QE medium. expected_cost_band: 0-4 findings pre-dedup, 120k-240k tokens. inputs: the tree at 800878a5 + changelog mirror; the four closed children; the #792 trail. returned + telemetry recorded here after.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 5 RETURNED (narrowed 3 lenses, uninterrupted, IN BAND: 300,733 tokens / 157 tools against 120k-240k — a bit over, the verify-depth pattern). Verdicts: #794 and #796 held; #793 and #795 incomplete. Stop: NOT reached, unanimous — round 5 of this layer, and still three real majors. Children filed: #798 (major security: default-ignorable UNASSIGNED code points — U+E0000, U+2065, U+FFF0-FFF8, unassigned tag block — are General_Category Cn, not Cf, so the category filter misses them; U+E0000 reached the terminal on the built binary; the category proxy covers ASSIGNED invisibles only), #799 (major security: the MACHINE form renders state-sourced strings — phase, scope, domains — and the diagnostic file/message RAW; serde escapes Cc but not Cf/bidi/tag; the last uncleaned sink, and it contradicts the text.rs scope claim), #800 (major SE+QE convergent: the post_load LOADER WIRING is unpinned — deleting value.post_load() leaves all 138 tests green because the unit test pins the logic not the call; plus the missing #789 hostile-path falsifier), #801 (nit collector). RECORD-ACCURACY ERROR, disclosed: the #795 close, the 800878a5 commit message, and the CHANGELOG all claimed a #789 hostile-path falsifier that was never added — a batched edit aborted on an earlier assert and I did not verify the test existed before closing. Corrected on #795; the standing conduct rule is now explicit (verify claimed tests present before closing; 2nd occurrence of the claimed-not-landed class after #763). TELEMETRY chosen=observed: fable all three, security/SE high, QE medium. CONVERGENCE ASSESSMENT: rounds 1-3 fixed members, round 4 fixed two classes (category, load) — and round 5 shows both class-fixes had a residual edge (unassigned-ignorables outside the category; the machine sink outside the render-site cleaning) plus a wiring-pin gap. The fixes are all clear and bounded, but five rounds of real majors on this one surface is past the decomposition's estimate. Surfacing to the operator for a scope/continue decision before the next fix pass — recommendation carried in the operator report.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Round 5 fix pass COMPLETE (52f94321; changelog mirror follows). All four children closed with tree-verified results — each test verified present before its close, per the conduct rule the round-5 record error established. The class-level fixes are now complete at their edges: the char class covers assigned AND unassigned invisibles; the machine form is cleaned at the state source boundary; the post_load wiring and the previously-misreported #789 falsifier are real. Gates: 141 tests pass / 0 fail, clippy zero, fmt clean, mdatron verify clean. Per the operator's decision (fix + verify), round 6 dispatches next as the stop-decider.

comments.author: xqjG
